data.professional_title: Regulatory & Transaction Reporting Analyst | MiFID II | Regulatory Reporting | Derivatives | Client & Stakeholder Management
data.summary: Regulatory Reporting professional with 4.5+ years of experience supporting regulatory reporting, reporting analysis, data validation, exception management and stakeholder coordination within financial services. Experienced in MiFID II, Solvency II, PRIIPs, SFDR, MMF and AIFMD reporting processes, with strong exposure to regulatory data quality, reporting issue investigation and timely resolution. Prior experience in Exchange Traded Derivatives and Middle Office Operations, including trade capture, trade controls, trade notifications and exception management. Experienced in coordinating with clients, brokers and internal stakeholders to resolve queries and operational issues.

responsibilities: Managed end-to-end regulatory reporting activities across MiFID II, Solvency II, PRIIPs, SFDR, MMF and AIFMD requirements, ensuring accurate, complete and timely reporting.
Performed daily and pre-submission validation of regulatory reporting data and outputs to identify missing information, data discrepancies, and reporting exceptions.
Supported MiFID II reporting activities, validating underlying transaction/reporting data, and ensuring completeness and accuracy prior to submission.
Investigated reporting discrepancies, exceptions and rejected outputs, performed root-cause analysis and coordinated corrective actions through final resolution.
Reviewed regulatory reporting outputs against source data to identify data mismatches, inconsistencies and reporting gaps, working with upstream and downstream teams for remediation.
Managed client-specific regulatory reporting queries and escalations investigated reporting issues and coordinated resolution with clients, brokers, and internal stakeholders.
Provided timely updates on open reporting issues, remediation actions and resolution status, ensuring effective stakeholder communication and closure.
Supported UAT and validation of regulatory reporting changes, including test execution, output validation, defect identification, and resolution before production implementation.
Supported regulatory change and client-specific reporting initiatives, including impact assessment, requirement analysis, process/control updates, and post-implementation validation.
Coordinated with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of reporting queries and delivery of regulatory outputs.
Supported quality control checks on regulatory reports before final delivery.
Maintained documentation and audit trails for reporting activities to support governance and audit readiness.
Participated in process improvement initiatives aimed at improving reporting accuracy, efficiency and control effectiveness.
Handled client and stakeholder queries related to regulatory reporting data, reporting status, and issue resolution.
Coordinated with clients and internal stakeholders to investigate reporting discrepancies and data-related issues.
Provided timely updates to stakeholders on open reporting issues, corrective actions, and resolution status.
Managed escalated reporting queries by coordinating with relevant teams and ensuring end-to-end follow-up until closure.
Supported stakeholder discussions around reporting requirements, data issues, and process changes.
Maintain strong relationships with clients, brokers, and internal teams to ensure smooth reporting operations and timely issue resolution.
Handled client-specific reporting queries and investigated reporting discrepancies, coordinating with internal teams to provide timely resolution and clear updates to stakeholders.
Supported UAT for regulatory reporting process changes, validating test scenarios, identifying defects and coordinating resolution prior to production implementation.
Conducted process walkthroughs and knowledge-sharing sessions for stakeholders/new joiners on regulatory reporting processes, reporting requirements and exception resolution
Managed end-to-end MiFID II Transaction/Regulatory Reporting, including transaction data validation, pre-submission checks, exception investigation and resolution.
Investigated reporting discrepancies, exceptions and rejected outputs, performed RCA and coordinated corrective actions through closure.
Handled client regulatory reporting queries and escalations, investigated discrepancies and coordinated resolution with internal and downstream stakeholders.
Supported UAT and validation of regulatory reporting changes, including test execution, output validation and defect resolution.
Supported regulatory change implementation and client-specific reporting initiatives, including impact assessment, process/control updates and post-implementation validation.
Performed daily trade capture and control checks to ensure accurate trade flow across systems.
Performed trade, position, and cash checks across T+1, T+2 and T+3 cycles.
Investigated and resolved trade-related exceptions in coordination with brokers, clients and internal teams.
Supported global accounts and worked with multiple stakeholders to resolve operational issues.
Followed up with brokers and clients to resolve reconciliation exceptions, researching and investigating issues through closure.

Bhopal School of Social Sciences, Bhopal
